title: Bounded anticanonical metrics on klt pairs and torus quotients

statements.hypotheses: projective Q-factorial klt (W,D), effective rational D, P=-(KW+D) nef, bounded semipositive pullback metric, chi(resolution,O) !=0
statements.conclusion: exists m>0 with mP Cartier and H0(W,mP)!=0

statements.hypotheses: smooth RC projective Z, smooth semipositive -KZ; every algebraic torus action
statements.conclusion: for each action exists m>0 with natural H0(Z,-mKZ)^T !=0

statements.checking: finite cover and degree d norm compared

proofPassages.read: Euler polynomial; positive unbounded twisting exponents; maximal dominated fibration; horizontal affine divisors and minimum vertical coefficients; discrepancy rounding and rank one for all a>=0; essential-supremum limit; small mixed metric; multiplier ideal O(-aH); vanishing at a=0; exceptional pushforward.

weight convention; ample/character perturbation only for GIT; stabilizer boundary and natural identity; convex arc orders; graph compactification for uniformity; orbit supremum metric and finite-slice descent; Euler premise and extension across every omitted divisor.
invariant product frame on universal cover; deck descent; finite étale norm
